title: Adding a new feature/route in public/app requires 4 coordinated changes
answers: What files need to change when adding a new feature page or nav item?
Why is my new route missing from the nav?
What must be updated together when extending public/app with a feature?
body: Traced through the 'notebooks' feature as an example: (a) route registered in `public/app/routes/routes.tsx`, (b) nav entry added under `public/app/core/navtree/sections/` plus registration in `core/navtree/buildStaticNavTree.ts` and an ID/weight constant in `core/navtree/constants.ts`, (c) a matching feature toggle in `pkg/services/featuremgmt/registry.go`, regenerated via `make gen-feature-toggles`, (d) if the feature has Redux state, its reducer/RTK-Query slice must be spread into `public/app/core/reducers/root.ts:createRootReducer()` — this is a manually maintained map, nothing auto-discovers reducers, so forgetting the spread is a common miss.
applies: Applies when adding a new user-facing page/feature with its own route and nav entry; simpler leaf changes inside an existing feature don't need all four.
